headline: Gujarat Natural Resources sets November 5 record date for 1:10 stock split
hook: First-ever stock split for the firm
summary: Gujarat Natural Resources has fixed November 5, 2026, as the record date for its first-ever 1:10 stock split following shareholder approval. Under the corporate action, existing equity shares with a face value of ₹10 will be subdivided into 10 shares of Re 1 face value each. The move is aimed at enhancing liquidity and retail shareholder participation in the oil and gas exploration company. Indian retail investors holding the stock will see their share count multiply tenfold while the total investment value adjusts proportionally.
why_it_matters: Share count multiplies tenfold for current holders
